as_told.title: Townsend Brown's Winterhaven proposal cites Heaviside gravity

plain: This story is about a document from 1953 written by a scientist named T. Townsend Brown, known as the Winter Haven proposal after the town in Florida. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes Brown as a scientist who worked on flying craft early on, and says the proposal looks almost exactly like the way insiders describe America's secret UFO program. In other words, Brown seems to have laid out, in 1953, a plan for the kind of project people now say exists. A second speaker on the same show, named Jack, also refers to the proposal. He adds that in it Brown praised Oliver Heaviside, a scientist of the 1890s, saying Heaviside had a good theory of gravity worth listening to. Both are speaking in their own words rather than quoting a witness. If the comparison holds, it would suggest the secret program had roots in Brown's ideas from the 1950s.
